_note: Calibration set for the Stage-1 gate (architecture-v2.md §3.4). Thresholds are set from the measured similarity distributions over this set — never from intuition. Categories: answerable (correct chunk known), unanswerable (no chunk supports an answer), cross-policy (answer spans two policies), adversarial (negation, indirect phrasing, wrong-number traps), transactional (order lookups — must NOT be retrieval-gated). expectedSlug/expectedSection name the chunk that should win; null means no chunk should support an answer.

provisionalThresholds.note: Starting points only. Run npm run eval with real embeddings and record the measured distributions + final thresholds in the README.
